name: Thermoplastics Engineering Corporation
old_description: For over 30 years, Thermoplastics Engineering Corp. has been a trusted provider of custom machine solutions for the wire and cable/fiber optic industries. We specialize in engineering custom machinery for the cable extrusion and wire coating extrusion process.
about:
Thermoplastics Engineering Corporation was established in the summer of 1986 in Leominster, Massachusetts. The company operated independently for over three decades before being acquired in June 2021 by Broomfield, a fourth-generation family-owned winding machine manufacturer based in Bolton, Massachusetts.

The company engineers and builds custom machinery for wire, cable, and fiber optic production. Its product lines include extruders, cablers, respoolers, payoffs, takeups, dancers, accumulators, capstans, control systems, and taping equipment. TEC also serves the plastics market with machinery for tubing, profile, and compounding extrusion. A multidisciplinary staff of mechanics, engineers, electricians, programmers, and machinists supports design, fabrication, and service.

TEC serves manufacturers in the wire and cable, fiber optic, and plastics extrusion sectors. Its equipment is used in the production of insulated wire, fiber optic cable, plastic tubing, profile shapes, and compounded materials. The company provides both complete production lines and individual machines to integrate into existing operations.

TEC differentiates itself by starting with a base machine platform and customizing it to each customer's unique requirements. The company emphasizes its experienced in-house team and its ability to deliver end-to-end solutions for fiber optic cable products, as well as its commitment to building dependable machines for the wire and cable production process.
